propositions: Identity transition logic including bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, and numeric-ID re-key must be extracted from BindingStore into a cohesive BindingLifecycle slice while preserving all existing behaviors and public facade signatures.
Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward and one matching reverse identity entry, with targeted single-key pops rather than sweeping or ambiguity detection.
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on the forward entry, popping exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep or abort, matching the reviewed base behavior.

Numeric-ID re-key (step 4 of note_absent_or_rekey) must be extracted into a named lifecycle operation that swaps both indexes and resets absence, leaving note_absent_or_rekey on the facade as coordinator.
Stale reverse entries may be removed only in these permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind with sweep, re-key, and _retire; any other removal must safety-abort.
Legacy records without numeric IDs must retain current behavior and not be rewritten on read.
